a: I'm Tran Anh Hao, but you can call me Rocky. I'm a Full Stack Engineer and ERP Technical Team Leader at CyberLogitec Vietnam in Ho Chi Minh City.

I also work directly with international clients and business analysts.
I have a Bachelor of Engineering in IT from Can Tho University (GPA 3.58) and a TOEIC score of 880.
Backend: Java, Spring Boot, NestJS, TypeScript and GraphQL, with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MS SQL Server and MongoDB.
Frontend: ReactJS, Next.js, React Query, MobX, Ant Design and MUI.
Tools: Docker, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions and RabbitMQ.
I design systems with microservices, Clean Architecture and DDD, and I work in Agile/SCRUM teams.
I've been at CyberLogitec Vietnam since May 2024.
Since January 2026, I've been an ERP Technical Team Leader. I own the project end to end: development, deployment, BA discussions and client communication.
In the Logistics division, I built the core DDD architecture of an enterprise module for a global shipping line.
I also delivered full-stack features there with NestJS, Next.js and GraphQL.

I built an accounting system's codebase, architecture and coding standards from scratch with Spring Boot, PostgreSQL and ReactJS.
On my own, I built a hotel booking system using microservices with Spring Boot, Kafka, PayPal and MongoDB.
I also built a product recommendation engine in Python using collaborative filtering.
With a team, I built a knowledge-sharing platform with NestJS, Next.js, Docker and PostgreSQL.
There I handled the full-stack, DevOps and database work.
Of course! It's on the desk in front of you.
